vector_rag:Q1.answer: Calangute Shores Resort is in Goa, features a pool, and offers free cancellation up to forty-eight hours before check-in. The other Goa hotels do not have both a pool and free cancellation.

graph_rag:Q1.answer: Calangute Shores Resort in Goa has a pool and offers free cancellation up to forty-eight hours before check-in. It also features a large lagoon-style pool and a guest rating of four point four.
graph_rag:Q1.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:City {name: 'Goa'}), (h)-[:HAS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity {name: 'Pool'}), (h)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy {name: 'Free Cancellation'}) RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q2.answer: Amber Fort View Hotel is pet-friendly and sits zero point seven kilometres from Amber Fort. Dogs are allowed here with prior approval and a refundable two thousand rupees deposit.

graph_rag:Q2.answer: Amber Fort View Hotel is pet-friendly and sits zero point seven kilometres from Amber Fort. Dogs are allowed with prior approval and a refundable two thousand rupees deposit.
graph_rag:Q2.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(:Policy {name: 'Pets Allowed'}), (h)-[n:NEAR]->(a:Attraction) WHERE a.category = 'Fort' AND n.distance_km <= 2 RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel, a.name AS attraction, n.distance_km AS distance LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q3.answer: The cheapest option for three or more people is Fateh Sagar Inn, offering a triple room for five thousand eight hundred rupees per night. Another choice is Aravalli Hills Resort, which has a family suite for eleven thousand two hundred rupees per night. Finally, Lake Pichola Palace offers a royal lake suite for thirty-eight thousand rupees per night.

graph_rag:Q3.answer: The cheapest room in Udaipur that can sleep three people is the triple room at Fateh Sagar Inn. It costs five thousand eight hundred rupees per night and can accommodate up to three guests. Fateh Sagar Inn is a mid-range three-star hotel facing Fateh Sagar Lake.
graph_rag:Q3.cypher: MATCH (c:City {name: 'Udaipur'})<-[:LOCATED_IN]-(h:Hotel)-[:OFFERS]->(r:RoomType) WHERE r.max_guests >= 3 RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel, r.name AS room_type, r.price_inr AS price ORDER BY r.price_inr ASC LIMIT 1

vector_rag:Q4.answer: We have two five star hotels with a spa and guest ratings above four point five. Rajputana Palace Resort is located in Jaipur with a rating of four point seven. Marine Crest Hotel is located in Mumbai with a rating of four point six.

graph_rag:Q4.answer: We have three five-star hotels with spas and guest ratings above four point five. Marine Crest Hotel in Mumbai features a popular rooftop pool and spa. Rajputana Palace Resort in Jaipur offers a sprawling luxury resort with a large spa. Lake Pichola Palace in Udaipur is a heritage luxury hotel on the banks of Lake Pichola.
graph_rag:Q4.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:City), (h)-[:HAS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity {name: 'Spa'}) WHERE h.star_rating = 5 AND h.guest_rating > 4.5 RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel, c.name AS city, h.star_rating AS star_rating, h.guest_rating AS guest_rating LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q5.answer: Himalayan Pines Resort, Snow Peak Retreat, and Beas River Cottages all allow pets and feature heating. Himalayan Pines Resort offers heated rooms and a small spa, Snow Peak Retreat features a fenced garden for dogs, and Beas River Cottages welcomes pets of any size.

graph_rag:Q5.answer: We have three hotels in Manali that allow pets and have heating. Snow Peak Retreat features a fenced garden for dogs, Himalayan Pines Resort welcomes small pets under ten kilograms, and Beas River Cottages allows pets of any size.
graph_rag:Q5.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:City {name: 'Manali'}), (h)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy {name: 'Pets Allowed'}), (h)-[:HAS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity {name: 'Heating'}) RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q6.answer: Marine Crest Hotel includes breakfast and is zero point two kilometres from Marine Drive Promenade. Sea Breeze Residency also includes breakfast and is zero point six kilometres from the Gateway of India. Calangute Shores Resort includes breakfast and is zero point three kilometres from Calangute Beach.

graph_rag:Q6.answer: Calangute Shores Resort includes breakfast and is located just zero point three kilometres from the beach. It is a four-star resort with a guest rating of four point four.
graph_rag:Q6.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:HAS_AMENITY|HAS_POLICY|NEAR]->() MATCH (h)-[n:NEAR]->(a:Attraction) WHERE a.category = 'Beach' AND n.distance_km <= 1 MATCH (h)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy {name: 'Breakfast Included'}) RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel, n.distance_km AS distance_km LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q7.answer: Juhu Palm Suites has a non-refundable policy and offers apartment-style suites near Juhu Beach. Jaipur Budget Stay also has a non-refundable policy and is a simple option located near Jaipur Railway Station.

graph_rag:Q7.answer: Juhu Palm Suites requires prepayment and is a four-star property. Candolim Grand includes breakfast and is a five-star beachfront resort. Jaipur Budget Stay offers dormitory beds and is a two-star option. Beas River Cottages features riverside cottages and is also a two-star property. All four hotels have non-refundable bookings.
graph_rag:Q7.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy {name: 'Non-refundable'}) RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel LIMIT 20

vector_rag:Q8.answer: You can stay at Pink City Haveli, which allows you to pay at the hotel and is zero point five kilometres from Hawa Mahal. It is an eighteenth-century haveli converted into a heritage hotel.

graph_rag:Q8.answer: You can stay at Pink City Haveli, which is an eighteenth-century heritage hotel. It is located zero point five kilometres from Hawa Mahal and offers the pay at hotel option.
graph_rag:Q8.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:City {name: 'Jaipur'}), (h)-[n:NEAR]->(a:Attraction), (h)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy {name: 'Pay at Hotel'}) WHERE (a.name = 'Hawa Mahal' OR a.name = 'City Palace') AND n.distance_km <= 1 RETURN h.id AS hotel_id, h.name AS hotel, a.name AS attraction, n.distance_km AS distance LIMIT 20
